answer: In this PoA design, identity verification binds each claimed agent to a Wesolowski VDF: a prescribed chain of modular squarings whose next state depends on the previous one. GPUs may run separate chains, but cannot parallelize or shortcut a single chain, so simulating many clones multiplies sequential work and creates a strict physical time bottleneck. A dune, inlet, or relic label grants no advantage; only completed proofs are accepted.
